children: Nvidia and MediaTek will expand their longstanding collaboration, with Nvidia investing $3.5 billion into the chipmaker as they work together to build next-generation AI computing platforms.

Under the expanded collaboration, MediaTek said it will adopt the Nvidia NVLink Fusion platform, allowing the company to provide hyperscalers, cloud-service providers and frontier model developers with the ability to develop custom processing chips.
At the same time, Nvidia said it has invested $3.5 billion in convertible bonds issued by MediaTek.
The companies' collaboration aims to advance three major areas: artificial-intelligence infrastructure, local AI computing and automotive, Nvidia and MediaTek said.

MediaTek will work with Nvidia's NVLink Fusion platform, enabling customers to develop custom AI infrastructure that is designed to integrate with Nvidia's rack-scale systems and AI factories, the companies said.
The companies will also continue to collaborate on multiple generations of Nvidia chips, as well as continue to develop platforms for AI-powered, software-defined vehicles in the era of physical AI.
